chars.OBAID: a 25-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair and a light beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and white shorts
chars.FRIEND: a Moroccan young man with a shaved head and thin moustache, wearing a red-and-white striped football jersey and black shorts, sunglasses pushed up on his head
chars.GIRLS: three young European women tourists: a blonde in a light blue sundress, a red-haired one in a white linen shirt, a brunette in a green bucket hat
chars.TOURIST: a tall European young man with a man-bun and tattooed arms, wearing an open orange floral Hawaiian shirt and beige shorts

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Windy beach of Essaouira, Morocco, old ramparts and seagulls far in the background. OBAID and FRIEND sit on plastic chairs under a beach parasol; the three tourist women and the tourist man walk straight up to them smiling and waving hello. OBAID looks surprised, FRIEND freezes mid-sip of a soda. Comic, curious mood.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot on the beach in Essaouira: the three tourist women stand smiling in the sun, hair blowing in the wind; in the foreground OBAID covers his eyes with one hand and looks away shyly, embarrassed, comic expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Under the beach parasol, OBAID leans to FRIEND and whispers behind his hand, both glancing sideways with suspicious, curious faces, wondering who these people are. Tourists slightly blurred in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The tourists sit down on the sand around OBAID and FRIEND's parasol in a small circle, friendly and relaxed; OBAID and FRIEND sit stiffly, awkward smiles. Essaouira beach, fishing boats in the distance.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The tourist man talks animatedly with big hand gestures to OBAID on the beach; OBAID nods politely but looks confused, eyebrows raised.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: On the beach, the three tourist women laugh and chat with FRIEND, who tries to look cool with his sunglasses but is clearly nervous, sweating a little. Light comic mood.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: The tourist man leans in excitedly and points toward the town of Essaouira behind the dunes, as if asking to be taken somewhere nice; OBAID and FRIEND exchange a quick hesitant look.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close shot of OBAID and FRIEND on the beach looking at each other with worried, suspicious eyes, as if afraid of being scammed; the tourists blurred behind them.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: The tourist man holds out a thick stack of Moroccan dirham banknotes toward OBAID with a big grin; OBAID stares at the money wide-eyed, hand half raised, shocked. Beach in Essaouira.
